summary: Stock Management: Purchase price saves with success toast but doesn't persist when packaging unit    is not set
description:
When editing a stock item, setting the purchase price without selecting a purchase price packaging unit shows a success toast message, but the value is not actually saved. This is misleading, as the user      believes the update was successful.                                                                     
This may involve both frontend and backend issues. The frontend should validate that the packaging unit is required when a purchase price is set, and the backend should not return a success response if the data was not persisted.  

  Steps to Reproduce:
Navigate to Stock Management → Items (/openmrs/spa/stock-management/items)

Select a stock item from the list to open the edit side panel             

Set the purchase price without setting the purchase price packaging unit

Save the changes — a success toast message is displayed                 

  Expected Behavior:                                                                                        Either:                                                                                                 
The UI should require the purchase price packaging unit before allowing save, or                      

The backend should return an error if the purchase price cannot be saved without a packaging unit     

  Actual Behavior:                                                                                          A success toast message is shown, but the purchase price is not persisted. Reopening the item or  checking the database confirms the value was not saved.
